findings.resolution: CDC and independently written LPT p9 corroborate virus acquisition versus meningitis; stale single-source assessment corrected.
Inherited emergency conclusions unchanged; neither rash nor complete symptom set required.
Inherited removal of unsupported forced-neck maneuver remains intact.
Practical communication checklist is not a validated diagnostic score; no mechanical second-source requirement.
WHO A.3 negative blood-marker limit; A.1.1/A.4 stabilization and selective imaging corroborate NICE. No delay to antibiotics preserved.

MSD TB independently corroborates distinct multidrug meningeal treatment; NIH HIV-specific cryptococcosis confirms immune-dependent duration. NICE specialist routing is bounded service guidance, not an unsupported efficacy threshold.

NHS ordinary flu/gastroenteritis resemblance needs no duplicated wording. NHS SAH supports bleed example; NSW independently confirms meningitis and/or septicemia. Emergency actions remain corroborated.

MSD/RCH/WHO give component-specific empiric selection and support-care evidence. NHS hospital fluids/oxygen and pediatric RCH seizure management read. CDC directly describes immune-risk viral hospital care; MSD offers complementary severe-illness/immune context, not fake exact second rule. Conditional hospital review is accepted within strongly corroborated emergency pathway.
Revised infant-feeding wording checked against Mayo infant warning and NHS/RCH age-relevant illness assessment; adult Healthdirect limitation retained. Recordkeeping is practical support.
CDC technical P8 supplies exact cold-growth mechanism, with FDA coauthorship/shared upstream disclosed. Distinct technical and patient writings are not represented as independent experiments.
Chinese over-one-month boundary now matches English and WHO scope. WHO and NICE hearing clocks and strength remain explicitly attributed differences; no invented identical global deadline.
Regional vaccination/prophylaxis scope stays bounded; UKHSA contact passage corroborates existing meningococcal contact action without exporting temporary Kent outbreak schedules.
NSW functional spleen and NICE1.1.8/1.1.14 added precisely.
NHS chemotherapy and CDC post-transplant medicines explicitly bound, with Mayo mechanism complementary.
New actual-read CDC maternal symptoms passage supplies precise second writing alongside FDA; common upstream acknowledged.
Added the already reviewed CDC Listeria symptoms source to condition.source_ids; citation-list closure only. Section text and ledger/source hashes unchanged.

bilingual_assessment: All current63 bilingual claims checked for matching population, condition, timing and action. Only infant-feeding and Chinese over-one-month text changed versus previous recheck; final evidence repairs changed links/ledger only.
independence_assessment: Same-organizational pages grouped; WHO Bookshelf is the same guideline, MSD pages one editorial family. LPT local writing with age of policy disclosed. CDC/FDA food-safety shared contributors and epidemiology remain visible; no independent-trial assertion. Critical actions use independently written guidance, exact attributed regional recommendations retain their disagreement.
resolution: Accepted for the described bilingual overview and14 sections; earlier partial evidence gaps resolved with actual component-specific reads or accepted bounded ordinary/practical statements. No claim is downgraded to evade a dangerous-action requirement.
